Our Coaching Process

Five steps, shaped around your goals and daily routine. Results differ from person to person.

  1. Free Consultation

    Understand goals, lifestyle, food preferences and relevant health considerations.

  2. Personalized Diet Plan

    Create a practical plan according to individual needs and routine.

  3. Exercise & Lifestyle Guidance

    Provide suitable activity and daily habit guidance.

  4. Regular Follow-Up

    Review progress and adjust the plan when appropriate.

  5. Long-Term Maintenance

    Help clients build sustainable habits and work toward maintaining progress.

About Us — Vajan.fit

Know who we are

Vajan.fit is a weight management and lifestyle coaching brand dedicated to helping people develop healthier, more sustainable habits. We focus on personalized guidance, practical meal planning, homemade Indian foods, balanced nutrition and everyday lifestyle improvements.

Our goal is to make healthy living practical for real people with busy schedules, family responsibilities and different food preferences. We believe that long-term progress requires more than a short-term diet. It requires education, consistency, personal support and habits that people can realistically maintain.

Our services include personalized nutrition guidance, Indian meal planning, lifestyle coaching, online support, progress tracking and weight-maintenance guidance.

Real Experience. Practical Guidance. Sustainable Habits.

Meet Our Founders

Jitendra Govind Gaur

Founder, Vajan.fit | Weight Management Coach

“I understand the struggle because I have lived it.”

My weight-management journey started with my own struggle. At my heaviest, I weighed approximately 136 kg. I experienced the practical and emotional challenges associated with excess weight, including low confidence, difficulty with everyday activities and the impact of other people’s comments.

Instead of relying only on temporary solutions, I began learning about nutrition, food habits and practical lifestyle changes. I worked on improving my eating habits and understanding how homemade Indian food could fit into a more balanced routine.

Through my personal journey, I reduced my weight from approximately 136 kg to 80–85 kg. My experience taught me that weight management is not simply about losing weight; building sustainable habits and maintaining progress are equally important.

After my own transformation, I supported my wife, Diksha, in her weight-management journey. Seeing these challenges firsthand helped us understand how important practical guidance, patience and ongoing support can be.

This experience inspired us to build Vajan.fit, with the aim of helping other people approach weight management through realistic food choices, education and personalized support.

My Mission: To help people understand their bodies, improve their everyday habits and work toward healthier, sustainable lifestyles.

Diksha Ma’am

Co-Founder, Vajan.fit

“My personal journey helped me understand the importance of patience, knowledge and consistent habits.”

In January 2021, following pregnancy, Diksha’s weight reached approximately 90 kg. She decided to take a more informed approach to her health by learning about nutrition, reviewing food choices and making structured changes to her daily eating habits.

During 2021, she worked consistently on her weight-management journey and reported losing approximately 40 kg over the course of the year. She continued focusing on maintaining her progress, and her experience through 2026 strengthened her understanding of the challenges involved in long-term weight management.

After her own journey, Diksha also supported Jitendra in his transformation. These shared experiences helped them recognize that every person’s circumstances, challenges and needs are different.

Her personal experience became one of the inspirations behind Vajan.fit. As Co-Founder, she contributes to the brand’s mission of offering practical guidance, encouragement and sustainable lifestyle support to people working toward their health goals.

Her Mission: To help people feel supported, informed and confident while developing healthier habits.

Transformation Stories

Real journeys, real habits

See what steady habits can do. Every journey is different, and individual results vary and are not guaranteed.

Transformation story−30+ kg

110+ kg → 80 kg

Losing 30+ kg does not happen in a day. It happens through ordinary days done well: homemade meals planned with intention, steady routines and regular follow-up. Small choices repeated every day add up to a result like this. Your first step can start today.

Transformation story−40 kg

90 kg → 50 kg

Going from 90 kg to 50 kg is a big change, and every big change begins with one decision to start. With patience, a practical plan and steady support, progress becomes something you can keep, not just something you reach. If you are waiting for the right moment, this is it.

In 3 months−20 kg

110 kg → 90 kg

Twenty kilos in three months shows what focused effort and the right guidance can do. Each week is a chance to build the next healthy habit, and each habit makes the next one easier. Start small, stay consistent and let the numbers follow.

Our Founder−52 kg

132 kg → 80 kg

Our Books & Products

Published

वजन का सच

Author: जितेंद्र गोविंद गौड़

वजन घटाने से पहले वजन का सच जानिए।

“वजन का सच” is a Hindi book about understanding weight management through practical knowledge, Indian food culture and everyday habits. It aims to help readers look beyond quick-fix dieting and understand the importance of informed food choices, consistency and sustainable lifestyle changes.

The book discusses common misunderstandings about weight, practical approaches to healthy habits and the role of familiar Indian foods in everyday nutrition.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters

← Back to the website

Last updated: October 2026

1. Who we are

Vajan.fit provides weight-management and lifestyle coaching, educational courses and books. You can contact us on WhatsApp at +91 95531 67666 for any question about this policy.

2. What this website collects

This website does not ask you to create an account and does not use advertising or analytics cookies. The Ideal Weight Calculator works inside your own browser: the age, gender, height and weight you type are used only to show your result on screen and are not sent to us or stored by us. Like most websites, our hosting provider may keep standard technical logs such as IP address and browser type.

3. Information you choose to send us

When you press a WhatsApp button, submit a review or contact us, your message opens in WhatsApp and is sent to us only when you send it. That can include your name, phone number, program of interest, your review and any health, weight or lifestyle details you choose to share. Please share only what you are comfortable sharing. WhatsApp is operated by Meta and is subject to its own terms and privacy policy.

4. How we use it

We use the information you send to reply to you, recommend a suitable program, deliver coaching you have asked for, and improve our services. We do not sell your personal information. We do not publish your name, review or story without your permission.

5. Reviews

Reviews are published only with the reviewer's consent. When you send a review you confirm that you are a genuine client or reader and allow us to publish your name, program, rating and review text. You can ask us to edit or remove it at any time.

6. Sharing

We share personal information only with service providers needed to run our services (for example WhatsApp or other communication, payment or hosting tools), or when the law requires it. Links to Instagram, YouTube, Facebook and other sites lead to services with their own privacy policies.

7. Keeping your information

We keep information only as long as needed to provide our services, meet legal obligations and resolve disputes. Health-related information you share is treated as sensitive and used only for the coaching you requested.

8. Your choices and rights

You can ask us to tell you what personal information we hold about you, correct it, or delete it, and you can withdraw your consent at any time, subject to applicable Indian law, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 as it comes into force. Message us on WhatsApp at +91 95531 67666 and we will respond to your request or complaint.

9. Children

Our services and the calculator are meant for adults aged 18 and over. We do not knowingly collect information from children.

10. Changes

We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top shows when it was last changed.

Health Disclaimer: Vajan.fit provides general nutrition and lifestyle education and coaching and is not a substitute for medical diagnosis or treatment.

Terms & Conditions

Clear and simple terms

← Back to the website

Last updated: October 2026

1. About these terms

By using this website or our services you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use them.

2. Our services

Vajan.fit provides general nutrition, lifestyle and habit coaching, educational courses and books. We are not a hospital or clinic, and our coaching is not medical diagnosis, treatment or a substitute for the advice of a doctor or other qualified healthcare professional.

3. Results are not guaranteed

Results differ from person to person and depend on many factors, including your health, effort, routine and following the plan. Transformation stories, weights and timelines on this website show individual experiences and are not a promise or guarantee that you will achieve the same result.

4. Ideal Weight Calculator

The calculator gives an estimate based on BMI. It is not a personalised medical recommendation, and BMI does not measure muscle, bone or body fat. It is meant for adults aged 18 to 80. Speak to a healthcare professional before making major changes to your diet or activity, especially if you have a medical condition, take medication, are pregnant or breastfeeding.

5. Your responsibilities

Please give us accurate information about yourself, tell us about any medical condition or allergy that could affect your plan, and consult your doctor when needed. Fasting and similar practices are not suitable for everyone.

6. Fees and enrolment

Program details, fees, duration and any payment or refund terms are shared with you on WhatsApp before you enrol. Please read them before you pay.

7. Reviews you send us

If you send a review, you confirm it is genuine and your own, and you allow us to publish your name, program, rating and review text on this website. We may decline to publish a review and may edit it for length or clarity. You can ask us to remove it at any time.

8. Our content

The text, images, courses and books on this website belong to Vajan.fit and its authors. Please do not copy, sell or republish them without written permission.

9. Limits of liability

To the fullest extent allowed by law, Vajan.fit is not liable for any indirect or consequential loss arising from use of this website or from following general guidance without medical advice. Nothing in these terms limits any right you have under law that cannot be limited.

10. Links to other sites

This website links to other platforms such as Instagram, YouTube, Facebook and WhatsApp. We are not responsible for their content or policies.

11. Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of India.

12. Contact and changes

Questions about these terms can be sent to us on WhatsApp at +91 95531 67666. We may update these terms from time to time; the date above shows the latest version. Please also read our Privacy Policy.
